     9	/**
    10	 * @file philox.hpp
    11	 * @brief Philox4x32-10 counter-based generator, host and device
    12	 *        (blueprint/wp/19-gpu.md §2.3, ADR-G3).
    13	 *
    14	 * Salmon, Moraes, Dror & Shaw, "Parallel Random Numbers: As Easy as 1, 2, 3",
    15	 * SC'11. A counter-based generator has no state: the output is a bijection of
    16	 * (key, counter), so draw j of path p is a pure function of (seed, p, j).
    17	 * That is what lets 10^5 GPU threads draw without coordination, makes the
    18	 * result independent of how paths are split between threads, blocks or
    19	 * devices, and lets an adjoint pass regenerate draws instead of storing them.
    20	 *
    21	 * Written here rather than taken from cuRAND or Random123 so that the CPU and
    22	 * the GPU run the same integer arithmetic and therefore produce the same bits;
    23	 * Random123's known-answer vectors are the oracle (tests/testPhilox.cpp).
    24	 *
    25	 * Layout used by the Monte-Carlo code:
    26	 *   key     = (seed low 32 bits, seed high 32 bits)
    27	 *   counter = (block of draws, 0, path low 32 bits, path high 32 bits)
    28	 * One Philox call yields four 32-bit words = two 52-bit uniforms, so draws
    29	 * 2b and 2b+1 of a path come from counter block b.
    30	 */
    31	
    32	namespace quantModeling
    33	{
    34	
    35	    struct Philox4x32
    36	    {
    37	        uint32_t v[4];
    38	    };
    39	
    40	    namespace philox_detail
    41	    {
    42	        constexpr uint32_t kM0 = 0xD2511F53u;
    43	        constexpr uint32_t kM1 = 0xCD9E8D57u;
    44	        constexpr uint32_t kW0 = 0x9E3779B9u; // golden ratio
    45	        constexpr uint32_t kW1 = 0xBB67AE85u; // sqrt(3) - 1
    46	
    47	        QM_HOST_DEVICE inline void mulhilo(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t &hi, uint32_t &lo)
    48	        {
    49	            const uint64_t p = static_cast<uint64_t>(a) * static_cast<uint64_t>(b);
    50	            hi = static_cast<uint32_t>(p >> 32);
    51	            lo = static_cast<uint32_t>(p);
    52	        }
    53	
    54	        QM_HOST_DEVICE inline Philox4x32 round(const Philox4x32 &c, uint32_t k0, uint32_t k1)
    55	        {
    56	            uint32_t hi0, lo0, hi1, lo1;
    57	            mulhilo(kM0, c.v[0], hi0, lo0);
    58	            mulhilo(kM1, c.v[2], hi1, lo1);
    59	            return Philox4x32{{hi1 ^ c.v[1] ^ k0, lo1, hi0 ^ c.v[3] ^ k1, lo0}};
    60	        }
    61	    } // namespace philox_detail

    64	    /// known-answer tests cover).
